# European put option The value of a European put option with the same characteristics as the call can be calculated with the help of the put-call parity: Put = Call + Bond - Share $$ \Leftrightarrow P = C + X e ^ {- r t} - S _ {0} $$ where: $P =$ price of the European put option $X =$ exercise price $S_{0}$ = share price today $C =$ price of the European call option. # Activity 3.4 Calculating a European put option ![](images/c3e506e11ab6213fd93108f14dd895899d014ccce5bd9e5c0147502628faa7a8.jpg) Allow approximately 20 minutes for this activity. Calculate the value of a put option that has the same characteristics as the call option from Activity 3.3 (repeated below for ease).
Current share price (S)473p
Option exercise price (X)470p
Risk-free rate (Rf)6%
r = ln(1 + Rf) = ln(1.06)0.058
Time to expiry of call option (t)2 year
Volatility (standard deviation of share price, σ)11%
Provide your answer... # Feedback The value of a European call option from the previous activity is: $$ C = S N (d _ {1}) - X e ^ {- r t} N (d _ {2}) = 6 3. 0 1 \mathrm{p} $$ Using the values given above in the put-call parity gives: $$ \begin{array}{l} P = X e ^ {- r t} - S _ {0} + C \\ = 4 7 0 e ^ {- 0. 0 5 8 \times 2} - 4 7 3 + 6 3. 0 1 = 8. 5 3 \\ \end{array} $$ The value of the put option is 8.53p. ![](images/d501595e3e6d8c8822dab06577f7bbe209f825ddcbee6469cf488a58f0a8eb42.jpg)
